导出只读取已提交快照，经系统选择器写到玩家选定位置；取消无副作用。
导入校验格式、游戏、兼容组、大小、清单与每文件摘要，拒绝越界和非法链接。

source_evidence.fact: Exchange has cleanup-only finally and no compensating rollback.

findings.refutation_result: Retained ZIP disproves total loss of all copies, not missing active-state rollback/recovery; mkdir before launch can mask missing active tree.

findings.minimum_fix: Recover owned journals before active-root creation/access; record old/new commit identities; compensate reported failure and reconcile selected tree/index before rollback cleanup.
findings.later_verification: Fault exchange/journal/index boundaries; interpose export/backup/import/launch; recover twice.

findings.refutation_result: A restored inert Confirm or deleted retry input violates required usable recovery, although the external source normally remains.

source_evidence.fact: Enabled dismiss/Cancel only deletes archive/context and hides UI; no operation cancellation.
After extraction archive is already closed; old-save backup and exchange continue independently.

findings.refutation_result: S16 explicitly defines cancel behavior. Closing the dialog cannot count as cancellation when later publication still happens.
excluded_overreach: Null SAF callback already invokes import.
Installation-section L64 is independently an import API clause.
findings.minimum_fix: Own/deduplicate operation, honor pre-publication cancel; disable/replace cancel/dismiss with truthful finishing state during brief protected exchange.
findings.later_verification: Cancel extraction/backup prevents publication; protected exchange exposes coherent noncancellable phase and durable outcome.
